branding.heading: Branding
branding.subtitle: What your customers' panel shows in place of the default: your name, your logo and your colour.
branding.nameHint: Shown next to the logo in the header of your customers' panel.
branding.colorHint: Used for buttons and the selected menu item. It must be dark enough for white text to be read on it.
branding.logoHint: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 100 KB. It is shown in the header, about 32 pixels high.
branding.logoUnreadable: The file could not be read. Choose it again or pick another image.
branding.saved: The branding has been saved. Your customers see it the next time they open the panel.
branding.previewHint: How the header and a button look to your customers. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
